product.title: Shine Star Family Matching Sweatshirts — Crewneck Tops
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Exact fiber content was not provided; the source size chart identifies the garment as a sweatshirt.
  • Family story: One unisex crewneck sweatshirt for children and adults, ready for coordinated family photos, trips, and everyday matching.
  • Print reference: A smiling star and the word “SHINE” create a bright, playful family graphic.
  • Design details: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, ribbed trim, and a relaxed pullover shape. Pants, skirts, hats, glasses, shoes, and accessories shown in the image are styling only and are not included.
  • Care: Check the sewn-in care label first; when compatible, wash cold on gentle, use mild detergent, avoid bleach, and line dry.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years and Adult S through Adult 4XL, all backed by the attached source chart.

Shine Star keeps the family look simple: choose each person’s chart-backed size, then pick from White, Green, Blue, or Pink. The shared star graphic makes the colors feel coordinated while letting every family member choose a favorite.

The source chart publishes garment length, chest, shoulder, sleeve, recommended height, and recommended weight. Weight ranges were converted from jin to kilograms. Because the source omits hip and waist, child hip is derived as chest plus 4 cm with waist equal to chest; adult hip equals chest and adult waist is chest minus 12 cm. Choose by the full chart and size up when between ranges or when a roomier fit is preferred.

Key Features:

  • Four requested colors: White, Green, Blue, and Pink are kept together in one product.
  • One family graphic: The same Shine star artwork coordinates child and adult sweatshirts.
  • Easy pullover shape: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, and ribbed trim create a casual layer.
  • Inclusive unisex sizing: Seven child rows and seven adult rows come directly from the source sweatshirt chart.
  • Single-garment scope: Each selected variant includes one sweatshirt; all other pictured pieces and accessories are styling only.

Choose each family member’s size and color to build your own Shine Star matching look.
